description: Phase FRP-7 V1.5 primary metric (supplement §22.1). Asserts that recipient.scan → first-tunnel-up completes in ≤ 60 seconds. Drives the FRP-6 recipient screens (RouteHealthBanner + AnimatedQrTab + WhyThisRouteScreen) against a synthetic .sbp import; verifies the engine reaches engine_diagnostics_explain.posture == 'connected' inside the budget. Recovery action on miss: surface a banner pointing to the recipient-side WhyThisRouteScreen plain-language explanation; the FRP can paste the resulting Explanation into the rotate modal.
